name: _default
note: What a score that names no output_targets is delivered as. A project can override this file (presets/outputs/_default.json) to change its own default without touching the engine.
sources: Stereo first, because it is the certified master and the file every other format is compared with (fold.mono, fold.timbre); immersive_7_1 second, the 8-channel deliverable. A 7.1 file alone as the first target was measured on a 117 s cue and failed three rows that fold it to two channels (clipping, true peak 1.6 dBTP over the -2.0 ceiling, master.dc), so it is not yet certifiable without stereo. A target the engine cannot build is never a default.
